map.⚖️ 保洁质量检查与考核评分: ⚖️ Cleaning Quality Inspection and Assessment Scoring
map.按区域逐项检查保洁质量，每项 0-5 分，自动计算区域得分、综合考核分，并依据奖: Inspect cleaning quality item by item by zone, 0-5 points each, auto-compute zone scores and overall assessment score, and give reward/penalty suggestions per the reward-penalty system.

map.综合考核分 = 各区域平均分之和 ÷ 区域数 × 20: Overall assessment score = sum of zone averages / number of zones x 20
map.每项按保洁质量评分：0=未做 / 1=很差 / 2=差 / 3=一般 / 4=良: Score each item by cleaning quality: 0=not done / 1=very poor / 2=poor / 3=fair / 4=good / 5=excellent
map.综合考核分 = 各区域平均分之和 ÷ 区域数 × 20（折算为百分制）: Overall assessment score = sum of zone averages / number of zones x 20 (converted to a 100-point scale)
map.单项得分为 0 的项目列为严重扣分项，需立即整改: Items scored 0 are listed as serious deductions and must be corrected immediately

map.外包保洁公司月度考核时，甲方按 10 项逐项巡检打分，作为付款与续约依据。: During monthly assessment of an outsourced cleaning company, the client inspects and scores 10 items one by one as the basis for payment and contract renewal.
map.保洁班组自查整改，发现低分项为优先处理对象，形成闭环记录。: The cleaning team self-checks and rectifies, treating low-score items as priorities, forming a closed-loop record.
map.新项目入驻前的承接查验，用统一标准确认交付洁净度是否达标。: Before a new project moves in, use a unified standard to confirm the delivered cleanliness meets the bar.
map.每项 0-10 分，地面 9、玻璃 8、卫生间 7、垃圾 10、异味 8、家具: Each item 0-10: floor 9, glass 8, restroom 7, trash 10, odour 8, furniture 9, skirting 7, fixtures 8, signage 10, safety 9, total 85, grade B (above pass).
map.默认均权每项 10 分，也可在表中为卫生间、地面等高风险项设更高权重，按合同执行: By default each item is equally weighted at 10 points; you can also set higher weights for high-risk items like restrooms and floors in the table, per contract.
map.通常总分 ≥80 为合格，≥90 为优秀；低于 80 应要求限期整改并复检，具体: Usually total >=80 is pass, >=90 is excellent; below 80 requires time-bound rectification and re-inspection; the exact threshold is set by the client.
